Rice na the crop wey dey need water and fertilizer well-well, and this my small plot for here na good land. I get 6 hectares in total, so I fit spare small money for NPK and urea — I go apply fertilizer because without am, the rice no go yield anything serious. I no go school but I don dey farm long time, and I know say rice wan improved seed if I fit get am from the agro-dealer for town. I go use my family to work but I go still hire small hands for transplanting and weeding because rice work plenty.
